{'text': '除了 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate RC 1 之外，Apple 亦正為 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 及 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 推出第三個開發者及公開 RC 版本。以下是詳情。', 'context': 'In addition to macOS 27.2 Golden Gate RC 1, Apple is also rolling out the third developer and public RCs for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.'}

{'text': '預計包含安全性修正', 'context': 'Security fixes expected'}

{'text': 'Apple 持續每週為舊版 macOS 推出 RC 版本，為正式發佈作準備。繼 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 首個 RC 推出後，Apple 現正發佈 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 及 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 的第三個候選版本。', 'context': "Continuing Apple's weekly RC rollouts for older macOS versions ahead of their official release, Apple is now rolling out the third release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, in addition to the first RC for macOS 27.2 Golden Gate."}

{'text': 'Apple 於上月底推出了 macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 及 macOS Tahoe 26.7.1，兩者均在正式推出前經歷了兩個 RC 版本。', 'context': 'Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 late last month, both of which saw two RCs before the official rollout.'}

{'text': '截至目前，Apple 為 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 及 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 第三個 RC 版本所發佈的更新說明，只提到包含「重要的安全性修正」，並「建議所有使用者安裝」。', 'context': 'So far, Apple\'s release notes for the third macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RCs mention only that they bring "important security fixes" and are "recommended for all users."'}

{'text': 'Apple 預計會在 macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 及 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 正式推出後公佈當中的修正細節，正式版本很大機會在未來數星期內，與 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 一併推出。', 'context': 'Apple will likely detail the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 after their official release, which will likely come alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate within the next few weeks.'}

{'text': 'macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 3 的發行版本號碼為 24H230，而 macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 3 則為 25G330。', 'context': 'The release build for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 3 is 24H230, while the release build for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 3 is 25G330.'}

{'text': '你在今次的 RC 版本中有否發現任何新功能或變動？在留言告訴我們吧。', 'context': "Did you spot anything new or different in today's RCs? Let us know in the comments."}
